revision_note: v1 of these criteria was never run. v2 removes every self-made quantity (oracle summaries built from the fact inventory, coverage and unsupported-rate reporting) after the user ruled out self-made metrics. Thresholds are unchanged.
purpose: choose one published entailment-based faithfulness family and measure its scoring cost on a Colab T4

data.sample: first 20 records per source-length tertile of a hash-ordered train sample (60 records)

summary_groups_per_record.lead: first complete source sentences within the budget
summary_groups_per_record.uniform: evenly spaced source sentences within the budget
summary_groups_per_record.random: seeded random source sentences within the budget
summary_groups_per_record.offtopic: lead sentences of a different train record within the budget
summary_groups_per_record.corrupted: the lead summary followed by three sentences of another record that contain a digit or a mid-sentence capital

families.rule: published packages through their documented interfaces only; a family that fails to install or run is recorded as unavailable with its error and is not substituted
families.pins: installed versions and checkpoint names are written to the receipt and frozen from that receipt

tests.G1_known_groups: per family, AUROC of the source-extract groups {lead, uniform, random} against offtopic >= 0.95
tests.G2_corruption: per family, share of records with faithfulness(lead) > faithfulness(corrupted) >= 0.90
tests.G3_cross_family: when at least two families run, median pairwise Spearman correlation across all summaries >= 0.60

reported_without_threshold: seconds per summary, peak GPU memory, projected GPU hours for 12000 summaries
admission_rule: a family is admissible only if G1 and G2 pass and the user accepts its projected scoring cost; G3 is a property of the set of families, not of one family
cost_threshold: none pre-registered; the user sets the scoring budget after seeing the projection
